source_scope: Every original annotation object and reference identity is preserved. One authored cluster-chaperone MF is appended. Generic positive screen associations stay non-core unless a verified partner class supports an informative refinement.

17376863.finding: Tagged human Miner1 localizes to a perinuclear reticular ER pattern; the paper's detailed mitochondrial import and membrane experiments concern mitoNEET.
17376863.access: Selected genuine normal full text, actual human construct/localization Results and Methods read. C-terminal V5/His constructs in COS7 cells are distinct from rat/mouse mitoNEET experiments.

19580816.finding: Human soluble Miner1 forms a homodimer with one [2Fe-2S] cluster per protomer and has measurable cluster redox potential and lability.
19580816.access: Selected genuine normal full Results and Methods read. Residues 57–135 carry C92S and a cleavage remnant; this paper suggests, rather than directly assays, cluster transfer.

19946888.finding: The study surveys membrane proteins in a human NK-cell preparation.
19946888.access: Exact main abstract retained. The original CISD2 target table remains unverified after bounded prior publisher/supplement attempts; independent human membrane experiments support the annotation, not a reconstructed NK-cell identification.

20010695.finding: CISD2 associates with BCL2, BCLXL and IP3R1 and helps BCL2 restrain Beclin 1-dependent starvation autophagy at the ER.
20010695.access: Exact main abstract remains selected. Genuine freshly fetched full text was independently read, including endogenous co-IP, ER topology, BCL2–BECN1 association, bafilomycin/LC3 flux and starvation experiments. H1299 4-hour-starvation assays do not establish a universal calcium or apoptosis effect.

22658674.finding: CISD2 is a statistically enriched HeLa mRNA-interactome protein in the original supplement.
22658674.access: Exact main abstract retained; authentic author full Methods and publisher Table S1 row 526 inspected. Ion-count enrichment passes whereas the spectral-count test does not; the study accepts either test. Protein groups are gene-level, without resolving an RNA target or every product.

32296183.finding: HuRI reports binary interactions for CISD2 with multiple screened human protein constructs.
32296183.access: Exact main full text retained. Selected Results, assay-validation and limitation passages read; all 56 original CISD2 partner rows have exact current IntAct records. Quadruplicate and orthogonal validation characterize the study, but individual CISD2 mammalian confirmation is not asserted without a matching record.

32814053.finding: The neurodegeneration interactome includes positive CISD2 yeast two-hybrid pairs.
32814053.access: Exact main abstract retained. Genuine author PDF from the MDC repository was read for screening and reporter controls; exact target-specific IntAct records support five original partners. No CISD2-specific mammalian confirmation or disease mechanism is inferred.

23717386.finding: Purified soluble human NAF-1 delivers its bound cluster to apoferredoxin in a redox- and ligand-sensitive reaction.
23717386.access: Selected genuine normal abstract retained; authentic PLOS full XML Results, Methods and legends were recovered and read. The permeabilized-cell mitochondrial probe measures labile iron, not an identified physiological cluster recipient. The paper's H9c2 species wording is not adopted.

24706857.finding: BCL2 BH4 and BH3 peptides bind soluble NAF-1, and a BH4 peptide destabilizes its cluster and accelerates transfer to apoferredoxin.
24706857.access: Selected genuine normal full Results and Methods read. Peptide arrays, native gels and deuterium exchange are separate from a predicted coevolution complex model. The Results says S92C whereas the earlier preparation describes C92S; an identical wild-type construct is not assumed.

19451219.finding: Mouse Cisd2 deficiency causes mitochondrial degeneration, increased autophagy and premature aging; endogenous fractionation supports an outer-mitochondrial-membrane pool.
19451219.access: Selected genuine normal full Results and Methods read. Damaged mitochondria precede broader tissue degeneration. This links the phenotype to mitochondrial autophagy without identifying Cisd2 as an engulfment enzyme or transferring mouse tissue measurements to a human assay.

17846994.finding: Human CISD2 variants disrupt splicing in Wolfram syndrome 2, and tagged human ERIS localizes to the ER.
17846994.access: Selected genuine normal full selected Methods and Results read. P19/HEK293 are expression hosts; patient lymphoblastoid cells show altered thapsigargin-stimulated calcium release. The historical zinc-finger interpretation is superseded by direct iron–sulfur structural chemistry.

39370046.finding: Cytosolic CISD2 binds purified BCL2 BH4, while its effects on BCL2-associated calcium signaling differ between bulk release and ER–mitochondrial contacts.
39370046.access: Genuine normal complete abstract read; full experimental body not recovered. The abstract reports submicromolar purified binding and co-overexpression/knockout contexts, not a universal direction of calcium regulation.

ontology.label: GTPase binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a GTPase, any enzyme that catalyzes the hydrolysis of GTP.

ontology.label: ubiquitin protein ligase binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a ubiquitin protein ligase enzyme, any of the E3 proteins.

ontology.label: syntaxin binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a syntaxin, a SNAP receptor involved in the docking of vesicles.

ontology.label: SNARE binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a SNARE (soluble N-ethylmaleimide-sensitive factor attached protein receptor) protein.

ontology.label: BH domain binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a Bcl-2 homology (BH) protein domain. Bcl-2-related proteins share homology in one to four conserved regions designated the Bcl-2 homology (BH) domains BH1, BH2, BH3 and BH4. These domains contribute at multiple levels to the function of these proteins in cell death and survival. Anti-apoptotic members of the Bcl-2 family have four BH domains (BH1-BH4). Pro-apoptotic members have fewer BH domains.

ontology.label: G protein-coupled receptor binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a G protein-coupled receptor.

ontology.label: cytoskeletal protein binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a protein component of a cytoskeleton (actin, microtubule, or intermediate filament cytoskeleton).

ontology.label: iron-sulfur cluster chaperone activity
ontology.definition: Binding to an iron-sulfur cluster and delivering it to an acceptor molecule.

ontology.label: transmembrane transporter binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a transmembrane transporter, a protein or protein complex that enables the transfer of a substance, usually a specific substance or a group of related substances, from one side of a membrane to the other.

ontology.label: BH3 domain binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a BH3 protein domain, present in Bcl-2 family members. The BH3 domain is a potent death domain and has an important role in protein-protein interactions and in cell death.

ontology.label: BH4 domain binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a BH4 protein domain, present in Bcl-2 family members. All anti-apoptotic proteins contain BH1 and BH2 domains; some also contain an additional N-terminal BH4 domain, which is almost never seen in pro-apoptotic proteins. Loss of the BH4 domain can diminish or abrogate anti-apoptotic function or even impart outright death-promoting properties to the protein.

ontology.label: negative regulation of autophagy
ontology.definition: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of autophagy. Autophagy is the process in which cells digest parts of their own cytoplasm.
